ns2:section.sectionText: In this seminar, you will explore digital archives, host a public film screening and engage in two online debates with local movements of racialized poor people living in the marginalized urban periphery of Cape Town. For a final project, you will curate these current and historical stories, experiences and expectations into a visually appealing digital argument for democratically resolving Cape Town’s deepening water crises as a viable local alternate to global water prescriptions to commodify urban water resources.
